finding: Caught stack proves BuildStaticContext -> ValidateNamedTemplateBindings -> CollectNamedTemplatesInDocumentOrder -> ExpandVariableName fails before ValidateNamedQName. The first guard did not resolve the ten regressions.
decision: Remove ineffective shared validator guard and wrap only ExpandVariableName at the named-template binding-collection call. Translate only leading XPST0081 for well-formed lexical QNames; preserve malformed-name and other diagnostics and existing namespace resolution. Retain the original cause as InnerException.
